description:
Shown in the suburb report as the 'Gross Yield' map layer in the Market section.

Gross rental yield for every mesh block in the suburb —
weekly rent x 52 over median price — with both inputs returned so the
number is checkable, plus the best- and worst-yielding pockets. Values
only; polygons come from ``/shapes/mesh-blocks``.
name: suburbs_market_yield_map
title: Gross Yield (by suburb)
